Subject: SprintHub pilot — credit ask + short extension?

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team loved the latency profile and the KV caching example. We have a small ask as we kick off the pilot: our dev sprint got delayed and we need a three-week extension on the trial window, plus an additional one-time 25k token credit tranche to finish integration and run a controlled load test.

We can commit to a public case study and one joint webinar if you can make the credit and extension work. We’re early-stage (pre-seed) so cash is tight; the co-marketing helps a lot on our side.

Attached: one-pager on SprintHub pilot goals (also pasted below). Happy to hop on a quick call.

— Ari

Hi Ari — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can likely accommodate an extension + bonus tranche but I need a quick internal check on the approval path and a few conditions.

Proposed terms I can take to finance/legal right away:
- Trial extension: +21 days (no change to pilot milestones).
- Bonus credit: one-time 25,000 token allocation applied to the trial project.
- Outcome commitment: public case study + 1 co-hosted webinar within 90 days of pilot completion.
- Basic ROI signal: we need a short demo with your product lead within 30 days and a post-pilot feedback form.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm we have room in the startup/pilot pool for an extra 25k and sign-off on the co-marketing ask? I can draft the DocuSign however legal wants a succinct SOW.

Ari — if this works I’ll follow up with a signed terms stub and timeline.

Best,
Jordan
